final: SELECT AVG(r), AVG(c) FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, (SELECT AVG(ili.product_price * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost) FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili WHERE ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost <> 0 AND ili.product_price IS NOT NULL) AS r, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili WHERE ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id) AS c FROM Order_Items oi)
